privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Sakani Dz collects a technical device identifier to secure sessions and improve app reliability. When you grant permission, GPS location is used to show nearby properties and places; it is not sold to third parties. Seller information (name, phone number, address, published properties, and subscription data) is used to create the profile, publish listings, enable requested contact, and administer the account. Data is used only to provide, secure, and improve the service, and is not shared without a legal basis or consent where required. For questions or requests to access or delete your data, contact the Sakani Dz team through the app support channel.
